focal_claim: Whether the fixed v1.5 examples show a dependable advantage over competent vanilla and v1.4 controls.

evidence_streams.source: 36 frozen public event streams and terminal receipts
evidence_streams.lineage: One episode per task/tuple/arm; provider/account not independently attested

independence_check: The new checking methods can refute a candidate self-check, but shared artifacts and a single task per lane are not independent studies. Repeated copies, report/workbook consistency and formulas derived from the same helper do not multiply corroboration. Official macro and synthetic operational sources do not jointly prove demand.

stream_results.generation: 36 natural completions; reported usage present; 20 provider reconnect errors retained
stream_results.execution: 18 restart passes; 17 main flows; 17 mobile widths; 2 persistent login panels; 10 burst transport failures; 8 eligible benchmarks
stream_results.arithmetic: 17 base-value matches; 16 correct pair analyses; 18 exact substantive source collections
stream_results.review: Concrete defects and some favorable examples; no uniform architectural or quality gain

agreement_conflict: Self-verification and successful processes coexist with wrong pair arithmetic, wrong cost selection and broken UI contracts. Several original checker failures were instead evaluator setup/race or rubric precision issues.
agreement_conflict_gap: Original outcomes are unchanged; diagnostics are separately versioned. Backend echo, billing, account-side isolation and human scores are unavailable. Scope is English greenfield coding and archive-based consulting with hooks off and memory unenrolled.
combined_evidence_state: Verified/computed bounded findings, with provisional interpretation and unresolved causal attribution.
calibrated_conclusion: v1.5 has selective useful examples and often lower consulting usage than v1.4, but no consistent net advantage over vanilla is established. Generated-artifact defects are not automatically OpenSocrates runtime defects. Candidate model profiles remain unvalidated.
flip_condition: Correct a concrete finding only if a controlling source, actual artifact/state or checker assumption contradicts it. A broader product-effect claim needs separately authorized independent task evidence or a defined subsequent implementation test; it is not a prerequisite to finishing this bounded analysis.
